name: std/ime
description: Typing the world's scripts: the input-method framework and its methods -- Arabic, Armenian, Ethiopic, Hebrew, Pinyin, Russian, Ukrainian and a Unicode fallback -- with the language switcher, the Unicode character databases behind them and the Unihan parser.
residual: Named 2026-08-24: nineteen modules that no package claimed, and together they are one subsystem. Out of the payload with std/gui, which they draw through.
UnicodeProperties and UnicodeBidirectionality are here rather than in std/text because what they serve is typing and rendering; both stop at Codecs today, which is std/gui's.
